venues.officialDisplayName: RaiBoC Hall〔大ホール〕
venues.eligibilityReason: 2026-08-31 production disposition reconciliation audit: the current official 座席表 evidence is complete and self-consistent (1F 938 / 2F 431 / balcony 28 / 多目的鑑賞室 3 = 1,400, all printed on the chart header and reproduced by a machine cell recount of the unchanged current PDF), so the venue remains a strong production candidate. The blocker is the repository transcription, not the issuer evidence.
venues.blockingReason: PRODUCTION DISPOSITION SUPERSEDED / TRANSCRIPTION DEFECT (RAIBOC + CHIBA PRODUCTION DISPOSITION RECONCILIATION AUDIT 2026-08-31): the promoted configuration raiboc-hall-large-standard/standard does not reproduce the current official 座席表 printed ID set, so the 2026-08-31 production promotion is superseded and the record returns to blocked. Machine cell recount of the unchanged current chart (SHA-256 a0bd5467ad87d6cc1ce26cf6b56d0cfc8c37f3dc5bdb60e39334003aedebac81) gives 1F 938 / 2F 431 / balcony 28 = 1,397 printed numbered seats, which matches the chart header (1階席938席・2階席431席・バルコニー28席) exactly and, with the 3 unnumbered 多目的鑑賞室 positions, its own 計1400席; so this is a repository transcription defect, not an unexplained issuer relation. Confirmed defects: (a) 2F row 2A (left 3-9, right 39-45) is printed on the chart and entirely absent from the registered ranges; (b) a further side-only 2F row between 2A and 2B (left 2-9, right 39-47) is also absent; (c) the 2G-2K side blocks are printed as split outer/inner blocks whose row ownership does not match the registered ranges; (d) 1F rows B/D/F/H are registered as contiguous ranges that include a seat 31 which is not printed (those rows end at 30 while A/C/E/G/I end at 31), adding 4 phantom seats. The historical implementation report is retained: its currentness, configuration and evidence work stands, but its seat set is not valid. REOPEN CONDITION: a separately authorized bounded re-implementation that re-transcribes the 2F in full (row 2A included) from the current official 座席表 PDF with two independent passes, resolves the 2G-2K outer/inner side-block row ownership from the chart structure, removes the non-printed seat 31 from 1F rows B/D/F/H, and closes with per-area mapped totals of 1F 938 / 2F 431 / balcony 28 against the issuer subtotals. The 多目的鑑賞室 (3 unnumbered positions) stays excluded, and the unresolved X-cross (1F row I) and diagonal-hatch (1F row R) mark semantics remain an open issuer question that must not be resolved by inference.

venues.eligibilityReason: 2026-08-29 bounded implementation: 現行公式の座席表（大ホール）は A仕様2,006席の完全な印字番号集合（固定席1,842／移動席(オケピ)156／車椅子席8、1階1,328・2階330・3階348）を公開しており、座席根拠そのものは代表configuration化に足りる。B仕様1,658席は総数のみで番号集合・除外席が非公開のため実装不可。現時点のblockerは座席根拠ではなく施設の休館予定である。
venues.blockingReason: RENOVATION / CURRENTNESS HOLD (SAITAMA-CITY-CULTURE-MAIN BOUNDED PRODUCTION IMPLEMENTATION 2026-08-29): 運営者の現行公式施設ページが「中規模修繕工事実施に伴う休館のお知らせ／令和9年6月1日から休館となります／休館中は利用受付及び施設利用並びに敷地内への立入りはできません／工事期間は2年間程度を予定」と公表し、さいたま市の公式施設ページも同内容を独立に記載する。休館開始2027-06-01はレビュー日2026-08-29から9か月後で、docs/VENUE_DATA_GUIDE.mdの12か月しきい値の内側にあたるため原則blocked。issuerは本工事が座席構成を変更するか否かを明示しておらず、同ガイドにより推測で例外判断はしない。座席根拠は十分であり、これはcurrentness blockerであってevidence blockerではない。再開条件は改修後の再開確認と改修後の現行座席表の公表。改修前のculturecenter_zaseki01.pdfは休館開始後にcurrentとして扱わない。
